messages:
Katherine: Quick sync  new SI (NorthCrest Systems) asked for a compact "boots-on" rehearsal that covers partner-only tile preview, certification badge issuance, SKU mapping, and the public flip. Can Eng/Ops/Marketing join 07:45 PT tomorrow?
Omar: 07:45 PT works for me. Ill bring the ingestion checklist and a sample tile payload. We should pre-provision the partner-only tile and then flip public during the run.
Priya: Marketing needs the partner quote + 3 screenshots by 06:30 PT for the asset pack. We'll share under NDA. Also want the embargo timestamp confirmed.
partner-lead: Embargo OK. Target publish time TBD but prefer evening UTC. Will accept assets under NDA only.
DevOps-Bot: Flag detected: `nc_si_tile_visibility` default: "partners_only". API: POST /flags/nc_si_tile_visibility {"value":"public"}.
Katherine: Ops, can you add a simulated ingestion failure to the run so partners can see rollback and comms flow? We want them confident in recovery steps.
Omar: Yes. Plan: 1) pre-provision partners-only, 2) run staging demo, 3) flip flag to public (dry-run), 4) simulate failed ingestion -> rollback to partners_only + CDN purge, 5) partner Q&A.
Priya: Add a timestamping step to assets so we can verify embargo enforcement. Also include the partner-facing incident message template in the deck.
Omar: Inline flip & rollback script for the rehearsal: ```bash
# flip to public
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" https://deploy.internal/flags/nc_si_tile_visibility -d '{"value":"public"}'
# purge CDN path
curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -d '{"paths":["/marketplace/tiles/northcrest-si"]}'
# rollback to partners-only
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/flags/nc_si_tile_visibility -d '{"value":"partners_only"}'
```
DevOps-Bot: Suggest simulated failure at T+2m with immediate rollback; will post a synthetic failure log to the rehearsal channel for partners.
Katherine: Good. For certification: propose a 30-min practical (deploy sample app, validate p50 < 250ms, pass 4/5 integration checks). Pass threshold = 80%. Fail => remediation lab + retake. Include scoring rubric in the deck.
partner-lead: We like a clear remediation path. Also, can you show how badging levels (trial/verified) work and the conditions for downgrades if telemetry slips?
Priya: Ill include a one-pager for badge tiers and the telemetry gates (example: 99.5% success rate over 24h for verified).
Omar: SKU example attached inline: NC-EDGE-1, NC-GPU-2, NC-ACC-L. Demo env: staging-nc-onboard-2026.
Katherine: Please drop the rehearsal deck + one-pager in the calendar invite by EOD. Keep the rehearsal comments terse to simulate a live launch.
marketing-bot: Calendar event created: "NorthCrest SI rehearsal - marketplace & badge" 07:45 PT. Invites: Katherine, Omar, Priya, partner-lead, ops-team.
Omar: Ill run the flip and the CDN purge during the rehearsal; will also validate logs 15 mins ahead.
Katherine: Final ask: create a short partner-facing postmortem template so if we rollback we can send an immediate update. Draft here: "We reverted your tile to partner-only preview after an ingestion error. Engineers are investigating; ETA 30-60m. We'll send updates every 15m." Keep it short.
partner-lead: That comms template looks good. We'll rehearse our side too.
Priya: See you all 07:45 PT. 👍
Omar: 👍
